jobs.description:
Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

On behalf of Simatek A/S, we are looking for a Process Engineer who will become a central technical resource in the company's Process & Proposal team and contribute to the continued development of customer-specific process solutions for industries worldwide.

About Simatek

Simatek A/S is an international engineering company specializing in air filtration, pneumatic conveying, dust handling, and process solutions for industries such as food, feed, grain, recycling, minerals, and industrial manufacturing. The company designs and delivers customized systems that help customers improve operational efficiency, product quality, environmental performance, and workplace safety. From its headquarters in Albertslund in Denmark, Simatek serves customers around the world and combines strong engineering expertise with a flexible and customer-oriented approach.

The position

As Process & Application Engineer, you will become part of Simatek's international Process & Proposal team with colleagues in both Denmark and India. Focusing primarily on solutions for the food, dairy, feed and grain industries, you will transform customer requirements into technically robust and commercially competitive process solutions.

Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will perform process calculations, size equipment, define system configurations and contribute to the development of tailored solutions that balance technical performance, cost efficiency and customer needs.

Your responsibilities will include

• Develop process solutions based on customer requirements and application data, identifying and solving technical issues in the process design

• Perform process calculations and system sizing for complete process installations

• Prepare and review process documentation

• Collaborate with suppliers regarding technical specifications and equipment selection

• Prepare technical proposals and quotations

• Contribute to the development and standardization of engineering tools, methods and solutions

• Work closely with R&D and the product management team to develop competitive solutions

• Support continuous improvement of process design standards and engineering practices

• Participate in occasional international travel for customer and technical meetings (approx. 20 days per year)

Your profile

We imagine you have a strong engineering background and experience developing process systems or technical solutions within industrial environments.

You likely bring:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree within Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline

• Experience within process engineering, system design or industrial solution development, with the ability to independently drive technical tasks

• Skilled in process calculations, equipment sizing and can read PFD and P&ID drawings

• Experience in preparing technical proposals, quotations or engineering project documentation is an advantage

• Experience from the food and dairy industry will be considered an advantage

• Professional proficiency in English. An additional language will be considered an advantage

As a person, you are analytical, solution-oriented and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You work in a structured manner, take ownership of your tasks and enjoy collaborating across technical and commercial disciplines.

Why join Simatek?

You will join an entrepreneurial organization where the distance from idea to implementation is short, allowing you to make a tangible impact.

The role offers:

• Flexible working conditions including the possibility of working from home, up to two days per week by agreement

• Attractive compensation package including pension scheme, health insurance and performance bonus

• An active social environment and employee association arranging events throughout the year

Interested?

Send your application and CV via the application button. We look forward to hearing from you.

For more information, you are very welcome to contact Senior Business Consultant Erik Bernskov at erik.bernskov@actief-hartmanns.dk or by phone at +45 41 21 13 29. All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

Actief Hartmanns manages the entire recruitment process on behalf of Simatek A/S, and all contact regarding the position should therefore be directed to us. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of age, gender, disability, ethnic background, religion or nationality.

jobs.description:
Summary

Please note this internship will be a minimum of three months, you must be enrolled as a student on a PhD course and available to start no later than 1st June 2027

Within Apple’s Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning organization (AIML), you can take part in the ongoing revolution that machine learning plays in daily life. Apple’s fully-integrated hardware and software provide unique opportunities to deliver amazing experiences, all while prioritizing user privacy. As an AIML intern, you will get to explore new methods, apply machine learning to solve ambitious problems, advance state-of-the art technology through research and publications, challenge existing metrics or protocols, and develop new theories that will impact the way we understand machine learning and the experiences it can enable. Come collaborate with some of the best in the business and help build the world's most innovative products and experiences.

Description

In an AIML internship, you will collaborate with researchers, engineers, and program/project managers to tackle innovative challenges. You will also receive technical mentorship and guidance that allows you to learn new things every day, gain practical skills, build real world experience, develop a greater understanding of our industry, and form valuable connections. Together, you and your team will partner to design and implement an innovative solution for a Machine Learning problem that is meaningful. At the end of your internship, you will have the opportunity to meet and present your work to AIML leadership. Where appropriate, you will have the opportunity to submit your work for publication at a suitable conference.

We are offering a research internship opportunity to work directly with our research team in Copenhagen, Denmark on projects ranging from multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) to multilingual speech language models (SpeechLMs). The internship topic can be fitted to the candidate's interests, with example topics including language interference and cross-lingual transfer, the effect of training data composition on multilingual generalization, low-resource languages and dialects, efficient adaptation and continual learning, self-supervised and multimodal learning, and interpretability of multilingual speech models.

Minimum Qualifications

• Working towards a doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, data science, applied mathematics, cognitive science, computational linguistics or equivalent.

• In-depth knowledge of deep learning and statistical machine learning, with strong Python programming skills and experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

• Research experience in multilingual or cross-lingual speech and language processing, such as ASR, speech LMs, or audio language models

• Interest in Speech and Language Processing

• Strong demonstrable record of publishing academic research in ML-related peer-reviewed venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML...), including language- and speech-specific ones (e.g. *ACL, Interspeech, ICASSP)

• Ability to collaborate with others and to deliver ML technologies aligned with Apple's core values: the highest standards of quality, scientific rigour, innovation, and respect for user privacy

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience training or fine-tuning large speech or language models

• Experience with language interference, cross-lingual transfer, or low-resource languages and dialects

• Interest in the interpretability and efficient adaptation of speech models

jobs.occupation: Lead Scientist in Computational Drug Discovery

If this sounds like you, and you are ready to take on a broad area of responsibilities, then you could be our new colleague.

Your new position as a Lead Scientist, you will execute structure-guided design and computational analyses with a focus on immediate deliverables and operational objectives, using advanced analytical and technical skills to support drug discovery projects from early hits through lead selection. You will apply structure-based design methods and modern AI/ML approaches to generate and optimize novel hits, working closely with experimental colleagues to translate structural insight into concrete design decisions. Depending on project needs, this may also include building and applying computational models to support prediction and design efforts. You will work independently and will help develop and maintain computational workflows and tools that support the wider Discovery Research organization.

**We Offer Exciting Responsibilities

**

• Co-develop discovery hypotheses and molecular design strategies together with experimental colleagues

• Provide structure-guided analysis and actively participate in drug discovery projects, from early hits to lead selection

• Generate de novo hits and optimize existing hits with computational methods

• Develop and maintain computational workflows within the computational drug discovery pipeline

• Develop and maintain computational tools for the Discovery Research organization

**Your profile

**A lead scientist with advanced knowledge and skills in computational drug discovery, comfortable executing tasks independently while knowing when to seek guidance on more complex problems. You bring strong technical proficiency to offer insightful advice, refine processes, and produce analyses that inform higher-level decisions and project optimization. You coordinate naturally with project teams and stakeholders across functions and enjoy translating computational results into real impact on drug discovery projects.

• PhD in Computational Chemistry, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field

• 3+ years of industrial or other relevant post-degree experience in computational drug discovery

• Experience with structure-based drug design tools and methods, including molecular modeling and molecular dynamics simulations

• Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with version control systems

• Familiarity with Linux and HPC environments

• Familiarity with AI-based peptide and protein structure prediction and design methodologies, and/or machine learning predictive models for drug property prediction is an advantage

**Your new team

**You are to join the team in the Medicinal & Computational Chemistry team, a mix of scientists at varying levels of experience and laboratory technicians, working together to drive structure-based and computational approaches across our drug discovery pipeline.

**Let's bond and be bold

**We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. We bond through curiosity and playfulness as a team, allowing ourselves to challenge common thinking and drive future innovation. Join us and let's bond and be bold.

Interested in bonding with us? Then please apply no later than November 27, 2026, or as soon as possible. The applications will be reviewed as they come in. While a cover letter is not required, please include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.occupation: Senior Technician – Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing (Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced downstream technician with hands-on knowledge of chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes? Do you enjoy working independently while sharing your expertise with colleagues?

**At AGC Biologics, we are looking for a Senior Technician to join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team in Copenhagen.

You will work in a dynamic, GMP-regulated manufacturing environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical expertise, adaptability, and attention to detail. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable production while helping strengthen the technical capabilities of your colleagues.

**About The Job

**As a Senior Technician, you will be responsible for executing downstream purification processes and ensuring that manufacturing activities are carried out safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

You will work independently within your area of expertise while collaborating with colleagues to meet production goals. The role requires strong process understanding, sound judgement, and the ability to adapt to different manufacturing setups without compromising quality.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Executing downstream purification processes, including chromatography, filtration, and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Operating chromatography systems, including UNICORN software, and applying your technical understanding during production.

• Ensuring accurate GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training, technical qualifications, and development.

• Sharing knowledge and providing hands-on training and guidance to less experienced colleagues.

As you become familiar with our processes, we expect you to take an active role in supporting the development of new colleagues and contributing to high standards of technical performance and GMP behaviour within the team.

**Who Are We Looking For?

**We are looking for an experienced technician with a solid understanding of downstream purification and a strong commitment to quality and compliance.

**We Imagine That You

**

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have an educational background as a Process Operator, Industrial Technician, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have hands-on experience with chromatography, filtration, and UF/DF processes.

• Have a good understanding of UNICORN chromatography systems.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute complex manufacturing activities and contribute to solving technical challenges.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work and development, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and understand when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

**Working Hours

**This is a night-shift position (18:00-05:04 or 20:00-07:04) in our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing department in Copenhagen.

You will work according to an established shift schedule (5-2 in a 14 days period) supporting our manufacturing operations.

**What We Offer

**At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

**We Offer

**

• The opportunity to work with different products and downstream manufacturing setups, developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting the development of your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values trust, accountability, and open communication.

• A collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• We offer an attractive compensation and benefits package, including pension, health insurance, and other benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

**Interested?

**If you have experience with downstream purification and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Interested?

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

**Apply today and join our Mammalian Downstream Manufacturing team at AGC Biologics.

****Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.
